title: Wso2am: In Apache CXF, the parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers did not fully enforce… (CVE-2026-107937)
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package affects Apache CXF's parser for multipart/MTOM attachment part headers. The parser did not fully enforce configured limits on attachment header size and count, potentially leading to denial of service. Versions prior to 4.4.0-r1 and 4.5.0-r4 are affected. A fix is available in these versions. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.5 with no confidentiality or integrity impact but with high availability impact.
